title: Advanced Insulated Armor Mod
intro: Advanced Insulated Armor Mod is a mod that, when used in Armor, increases the player's biome hazards effects protection by 400%. This means that the base timer is set to twelve minutes, instead of the base three minutes. "Increases the survival time of storms by 400% before taking damage." - In-game description Currently (v2.4 b7), it is not possible to craft, as the knowledge to unlock the recipe does not exist. It can only be spawned in Debug mode, but it has no functionality.
description: Increases the survival time of storms by 400% before taking damage.

title: Robotic Drone Armor Plating Mod
intro: The Robotic Drone Armor Plating Mod is a Mod that reduces damage by 50% for the Robotic Drone.
description: "Upgrade your robotic drone's defensive ability with this modification. Reduces damage by 50%"

title: Robotic Drone Cargo Mod
intro: The Robotic Drone Cargo Mod increases the Robotic Drones storage from the default 16 slots to a total of 24. This Robotic Drone Cargo Mod adds 8 storage slots to the Drone and can be stacked along with more mods of the same type to increase so long as Quality of the Drone permits it and is not limited to one Modifier slot. A total of 4 Robotic Drone Cargo Mods can be added to the highest quality Robotic Drone, Quality 6.
description: "Increase your drone's storage capacity with this modification. Add more for additional storage"

title: Robotic Drone Medic Mod
intro: The Robotic Drone Medic Mod allows for the Robotic Drone to automatically heal the player so long as sufficient medical supplies are placed in its inventory. For added storage space insert the Robotic Drone Cargo Mod so long as the Quality of the Robotic Drone allows for additional Mods in the modifier slot. Multiple stacks of the same medical supplies is allowed.
description: "Modify your drone into a robotic field medic that will automatically heal you as long as medical bandages or first aid kits in its inventory"

title: Robotic Drone Morale Booster Mod

description: "Stamina regeneration is increased by 10% when near the drone with this mod installed."

title: Vehicle Armor Mod

description: Reinforced armor for motorcycles and gyrocopters.
effects: Increases damage to blocks and entities and reduces damage taken.

title: Vehicle Expanded Seating Mod
intro: Vehicle Expanded Seating Mod Doubles the available vehicle seats. Vehicle Expanded Seating Mod can only be installed onto motorized vehicles and cannot be installed in Bicycle or Gyrocopter.
description: "Expand your seating capacity in vehicles with this mod."

title: Vehicle Fuel Saver Mod
intro: Decreases Fuel Consumption by installing this modification into your motorized vehicles. Vehicle Fuel Saver Mod can only be installed on motorized vehicles and cannot be installed on the Bicycle.
description: "Vehicles consume less fuel"

title: Vehicle Off Road Highlights Mod
intro: Increases Headlight's Strength significantly by x2.2 , thus giving you the ability to see much better in the dark. Vehicle Off Road Highlights Mod can be installed in all drivable Vehicles except Bicycle or Gyrocopter.
description: "These off road headlights will brighten the path even on the darkest of nights."

description: A rugged 4x4 plow. Perfect for clearing paths through hordes of zombies.
effects: Increases damage to blocks and entities and reduces damage taken.

title: Vehicle Reserve Fuel Tank Mod

description: "Increase your vehicle fuel storage by 50% with this mod."

title: Vehicle Super Charger Mod
intro: Vehicle Super Charger Mod Increases Top Speed and Acceleration. Vehicle Super Charger Mod can be installed in all drivable Vehicles except the Bicycle.
description: "This super charger mod Increases vehicle acceleration and top speed."

title: Water Filter
intro: The Water Filter is a crafting item in 1.0 It is a modification to the Dew Collector and can be obtained from Traders as a quest reward or purchased. A less reliable method is to find broken down Dew Collectors at certain POIs which might yield a Water Filter after being destroyed.

title: Water Purifier Mod
intro: Allows any water to be consumed while installed in your helmet. Useful for conserving space by carrying a single stack of 125 Murky Water as opposed to the roughly 6 stacks of Water you'd need to carry for the same amount of hydration. (Murky Water hydrates half as much as the Boiled Water.)
effects: Allows any water to be drunk without harmful effects.

title: Weapon Flashlight Mod

title: Weighted Head Mod
intro: Adds a 15% chance to stun and slow victims.
effects: Adds a chance to stun and slow victims.

title: Wood Splitter Mod
intro: 15% more damage against wood. In Alpha 21, Wood Splitter Mod can be directly scrapped into Iron for 112 Iron, or smelted for 150 Iron in the Forge.
